name: Augusta Longbottom
life: Retired school librarian, widowed, lives on Social Security plus her IRA. Her grandson Neville set up Beobeo for her on an iPad. Reads with large text.
aesthetic: Big readable numbers, few words, nothing flashing. Gets anxious when there are too many charts or red numbers.
strategy: Puts a fixed amount in each month and keeps 60% stocks / 40% bonds like her advisor told her years ago. Never sells unless she needs cash.
biases: loss aversion — a red day ruins her afternoon
afraid of pressing the wrong button
goals: understand if she is OK at a glance
typicalQuestions: How much do I have in total?
Did I lose money this month?
Do I have to pay tax on this?
